one_sentence_story: A single amber pulse leaves a source artifact, crosses a transparent Context Capsule, reaches a torus family whose cusp opens a hexagonal fibre, and closes as a receipt-backed S6 paper claim with a visible world trace.
evidence_boundary: The ImageGen reference supplies visual grammar only. Source pointers, World traces, and render receipts are the operational evidence boundary.

beats.title: Source before conclusion
beats.causal_move: One source-bound amber pulse leaves a fixed artifact; nothing else moves.
beats.visual: A warm paper sheet sits on a copper hexagonal stratum at frame left. A single amber dot detaches and becomes a thin filament. The sheet uses readable labels only: SOURCE.
beats.voiceover: Start with one source artifact, not with the conclusion.

beats.title: Context changes the route
beats.causal_move: The pulse enters the transparent capsule, which exposes its context boundary without changing the pulse.
beats.visual: The amber filament passes through a glass rectangular capsule. A thin cyan outline appears around the capsule; the pulse remains amber, making source and context visually distinct.
beats.voiceover: Context does not become evidence; it makes the route inspectable.

beats.title: One route, one unresolved gap
beats.causal_move: The capsule emits one blue continuation toward a torus family, while a deliberately missing filament segment stays visible.
beats.visual: The camera tracks the pulse from the capsule to three nested torus rings. The middle ring has one open arc aligned with the incoming route; the gap is held in negative space rather than filled by decoration.
beats.voiceover: The thread can travel, but one link is still unresolved.

beats.title: The cusp is a test point
beats.causal_move: At the torus cusp, the blue filament forks into a hexagonal fibre; the fork tests the claim but does not prove it.
beats.visual: The open torus arc tightens to a luminous cusp. A small hexagonal fibre rotates once and receives the pulse. The torus family remains visible behind it, preserving object continuity and the missing-segment scar.
beats.voiceover: At the cusp, the paper's S6 statement becomes a claim to test, not a fact to inherit.

beats.title: Close with receipt, leave the world trace
beats.causal_move: Only a matched world trace closes the filament into a receipt seal; the unresolved remainder stays outside the seal.
beats.visual: The hexagonal fibre sends a blue pulse to a white receipt sheet at frame right. Hash ticks lock into a closed luminous volume, while a short unsealed tail points to a small WORLD TRACE marker. The seal closes the evidence thread, not the theorem.
beats.voiceover: The S6 paper claim closes here only as a receipt-backed claim; whatever the world trace cannot match remains open.

caption_script.hook: What if a proof film followed one trace instead of showing a finished diagram?
lines: A source artifact emits one pulse.
Context makes the route inspectable, not true.
A missing segment keeps the question alive.
At the cusp, the S6 paper statement is shown as a claim under test.
Only a matched world trace can close the receipt; the rest stays open.
caption_script.closing: Evidence is a route with a receipt, not a glow that looks like certainty.
caption_script.alt_text: Dark hexagonal terrain carries an amber source pulse through a transparent capsule into nested torus rings; a cusp opens a hexagonal fibre before a matched world trace closes a receipt seal, while an unresolved tail remains visible.

manim_plan.frame: 16:9, 1280x720, fixed camera with one dolly from source to receipt
objects: Polygon(6 vertices) for each hexagonal stratum
Rectangle plus five short Lines for the source and receipt sheets; no pseudo-text
Three ParametricFunction torus arcs with one deterministic gap from theta=0.32 to theta=0.68
Torus-like receipt seal with eight fixed hash ticks
animation_rules: Create all persistent objects before play; animate only opacity, stroke width, position, and rotation.
Use LaggedStart for one pulse only; no random seeds, noise, or camera shake.
At beat 3, never draw the missing arc; hold it for 1 second.
At beat 5, animate seal closure only after a named world_trace_match event in the scene code.
End on a 2-second hold with the unsealed tail visible.

falsifier: Reject this candidate if the source artifact, the world trace, or the render receipt is absent; if the torus gap is filled before the match event; or if the S6 statement is narrated as established fact rather than as a paper claim.
